# Game Idea: Solar Flare Dodge

A side‑scrolling HTML canvas game where the player pilots a small spaceship that must dodge randomly generated solar flares. The ship can thrust up/down to avoid collisions. **Lose condition:** collision with a flare or running out of fuel after a time limit.

1: // Solar Flare Dodge – simple canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   let audioStarted = false;
7:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
8:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
9:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
10:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
11:     osc.type = 'sine';
12:     osc.connect(gain);
13:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
16:     osc.start();
17:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
18:   }
19:   // Thrust sound (short high‑pitched beep)
20:   function thrustSound() { playTone(600, 80); }
21:   // Collision / game over sound (lower pitch longer)
22:   function collisionSound() { playTone(200, 400); }
23:   // Simple background hum (periodic low tone)
24:   setInterval(() => playTone(120, 200), 3000);
25: 
26:

28:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
29:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
30:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
31:   // Set size – you can adjust via CSS, default 800x400
32:   // Create background stars
33:   const starCount = 120;
34:   const stars = Array.from({ length: starCount }, () => ({
35:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
36:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
37:     r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
38:     speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3,
39:   }));
40:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
41:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 400;
42: 
43:   // Game settings
44:   const ship = { x: 80, y: canvas.height / 2, w: 30, h: 20, vy: 0, thrust: 0.4 };
45:   const flares = [];
46:   const flareSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
47:   const flareSpeed = 2;
48:   const maxFuel = 30; // seconds
49:   let fuel = maxFuel;
50:   let lastSpawn = 0;
51:   let lastTime = 0;
52:   let over = false;
53:   let soundPlayed = false;
54: 
55:   // Input handling
56:   const keys = {};
57:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
58:     keys[e.code] = true;
59:     if (!audioStarted) { audioCtx.resume(); audioStarted = true; }
60:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'ArrowDown') thrustSound();
61:   });
62:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
63: 
64:   function spawnFlare() {
65:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
66:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - size);
67:     flares.push({ x: canvas.width, y, w: size, h: size });
68:   }
69: 
70:   function update(dt) {
71:     // Fuel consumption
72:     fuel -= dt / 1000;
73:     if (fuel <= 0) {
74:       over = true;
75:     }
76: 
77:     // Ship control – ArrowUp / ArrowDown
78:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.vy -= ship.thrust;
79:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.vy += ship.thrust;
80:     ship.vy *= 0.97; // simple drag
81:     ship.y += ship.vy;
82:     // Clamp ship inside canvas
83:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
84: 
85:     // Move background stars for parallax effect
86:     stars.forEach(star => {
87:       star.x -= star.speed;
88:       if (star.x < 0) {
89:         star.x = canvas.width;
90:         star.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
91:       }
92:     });
93: 
94:     // Move flares
95:     flares.forEach(f => (f.x -= flareSpeed));
96:     // Remove off‑screen
97:     while (flares.length && flares[0].x + flares[0].w < 0) flares.shift();
98: 
99:     // Spawn new flares
100:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > flareSpawnInterval) {
101:       spawnFlare();
102:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
103:     }
104: 
105:     // Collision detection
106:     for (const f of flares) {
107:       if (
108:         ship.x < f.x + f.w &&
109:         ship.x + ship.w > f.x &&
110:         ship.y < f.y + f.h &&
111:         ship.y + ship.h > f.y
112:       ) {
113:         over = true;
114:         break;
115:       }
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Play collision sound once when game ends

132:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
133:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

147:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#66ff66');
148:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#009900');
149:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
150:     ctx.beginPath();
151:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
152:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
153:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
154:     ctx.closePath();
155:     ctx.fill();
156:     // Flares – glowing orange circles with radial gradient
157:     flares.forEach(f => {
158:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
159:         f.x + f.w / 2,
160:         f.y + f.h / 2,
161:         0,
162:         f.x + f.w / 2,
163:         f.y + f.h / 2,
164:         f.w / 2
165:       );
166:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.9)');
167:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 80, 0, 0.1)');
168:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
169:       ctx.beginPath();
170:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.w / 2, f.y + f.h / 2, f.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
171:       ctx.fill();
172:     });
173:     // Fuel bar
174:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
175:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 10);
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
177:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, (fuel / maxFuel) * 100, 10);
178:     // Game over text
179:     if (over) {

183:     }
184:   }
